## Accessibility Check

- [ ] Color contrast passes WCAG AA (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text)
- [ ] Touch targets ≥ 44px on mobile
- [ ] Form labels present for all inputs
- [ ] Error states are descriptive, not just color changes
- [ ] Works without mouse — tab/keyboard navigation functional
- [ ] Screen reader compatibility considered
- [ ] No reliance on color alone to convey information
- [ ] Focus states visible and logical

---

## Mobile / Context-of-Use Check *(if applicable)*

- [ ] Works one-handed
- [ ] Glanceable — key info visible without scrolling
- [ ] Core action reachable in ≤ 2 taps
- [ ] No hover-dependent interactions
- [ ] Readable in bright light conditions
